title: Build Sticky Header with India Circus-Inspired Mega-Menu and Announcement Bar
description: Create the top announcement banner, sticky parchment header, multi-column mega-menu with visual category previews (Custom Framing, Ready-Made, Gallery Walls), and mobile navigation drawer.
acceptanceCriteria: Top announcement bar displays shipping and craftsmanship guarantees with dismiss action
Sticky header features responsive blur, wordmark, search, account, and cart drawer triggers
Hovering over navigation items reveals a multi-column mega-menu with featured moulding thumbnails
Mobile drawer navigation is fully accessible and responsive

steps.details: Create components/navigation/announcement-bar.tsx with rotating or highlighted delivery promise.
Create components/navigation/site-header.tsx and mega-menu.tsx with accessible hover interactions.
Create components/navigation/mobile-nav.tsx supporting smooth sliding transition on touch devices.

steps.description: Verify navigation and mega-menu in browser
steps.details: Run Playwright test and capture screenshot of expanded mega-menu.
